errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the title of the chart, which is "Humour".
The bars are not all blue; they are four different colors (blue, orange, green, and purple).
The bar for V1 has a value of 71.4, not 71.9. The value 71.9 corresponds to V3.
The bar for V3 has a value of 71.9, not 68.5. The value 68.5 corresponds to V2.
The bar for V4 has a value of 68.15, not 71.4. The value 71.4 corresponds to V1.

errors.text_span: All bars are of equal length, indicating that each prompt received the same score on the GEMBA-SQM scale.
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The bars are clearly of different heights, representing four distinct scores (71.4, 68.5, 71.9, 68.15), not the same score.
